svg.text: Two real-time engines must never run together. Defender Antivirus covers the short gap; the job is to keep that gap short, never to skip it.

svg.text: Never two active real-time engines at once

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both engines insert a file-system minifilter into the Windows I/O path, so every file open is scanned twice: slowness, deadlocks,

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mutual quarantine and blue screens. Inspect the stack with fltmc filters; confirm the gap with Get-MpComputerStatus (AMRunningMode Normal).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
